meta_description: Johns Painting & Decorating Liverpool. Professional interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes, reliable service.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior painting. Free quotes, no mess, finished on time.
services_heading: Professional Painting & Decorating Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: From interior feature walls to complete exterior repaints, we handle all painting and decorating work with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Complete room makeovers including wall preparation, emulsion, gloss, and eggshell finishes. We protect your furniture and leave your home clean and ready to move back into.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior repaints using quality masonry and gloss paints. Our work protects your property and enhances kerb appeal for years to come.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging, pattern matching, and feature wall creation. We prep surfaces properly to ensure a flawless finish that lasts.

services.title: Woodwork & Gloss Finishing
services.desc: Expert sanding, priming, and gloss application for doors, skirting boards, and window frames. Durable finishes that look fresh and stay protected.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Shop fronts, office spaces, and commercial properties painted to your brand standards. We work around your business hours and minimise disruption.

services.title: Paint Colour Consultation
services.desc: Help choosing the right colours and finishes for your space. We bring samples to your home so you see them in natural light before committing.

about_pullquote: I started this business to do the job right, every single time.
about_para_1: Johns Painting & Decorating has been transforming homes and businesses across Liverpool and Prescot for over 20 years. John began the business after years working for larger decorating firms, frustrated by rushed jobs and poor attention to detail. Today, he leads a small team of skilled painters who take pride in leaving every property better than they found it.
about_para_2: We're known for turning up on time, protecting your belongings, and delivering work that looks sharp and lasts. Most customers come back to us for their next project, and many recommend us to friends and family. We're honest about costs, transparent about timescales, and we always clean up properly before we leave.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had John round to paint our lounge and hallway. Turned up when he said he would, did a brilliant job, and left the place spotless. Prices were fair and he even helped us choose the right colours. Can't fault him. Will definitely be using again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: We needed our whole house redecorating inside. John and his team worked through it methodically. They protected everything, didn't make a mess, and finished bang on schedule. The quality is really high. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret C.

reviews.text: Exterior repaint that I'd been putting off for years. John gave a realistic quote, explained what needed doing, and got on with it. Looks fantastic now. He's honest, reliable, and takes pride in his work. Top marks.
reviews.author: Robert K.
